_help: Playback singing (films, TV title tracks, jingles). sections = the tabs on the page (id = the part after # in the address, e.g. playback/#films; label = tab name; intro = optional text; emptyText = shown while a section has nothing; playlistId = the YouTube playlist of that section: the code after 'list=' in the playlist link; the daily YouTube sync copies its videos here automatically, newest first; hideVideoIds = videos of that playlist you do NOT want shown; a tab without videos and without playlist stays hidden; a tab with 'href' is a link to another page, e.g. Originals). items = entries you add yourself; they appear before/among the playlist videos and can carry more detail. Item fields: id (unique), section (one of the section ids), title, film (film or serial name), language (optional), year, date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), videoId (leave empty to take the matching video from the section's playlist automatically), matchTitle (optional: words that appear in that video's YouTube title, e.g. 'chal re mana'), credits (one short line), description, award (short award line shown on the card), awardId (id of the entry in awards.json, makes the award line a link), listenUrl, spotifyUrl, featured (true = shown large first), source. Never add song lyrics. Fields starting with _ are notes and never shown.
